description: This file defines the custom exception class 'PolicyInvalidException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It indicates that a certain policy associated with a 'Thing' is invalid, providing builder methods and JSON deserialization support.

classes.name: PolicyInvalidException
classes.description: A specific exception indicating that a policy for a 'Thing' is invalid. It extends 'DittoRuntimeException' and implements 'ThingException'. It includes methods for building instances with context such as permissions and 'ThingId', and supports JSON deserialization.

classes.name: PolicyInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of 'PolicyInvalidException'. It offers a fluent API to set message, description, cause, headers, and other properties, ensuring proper initialization.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for a 'PolicyInvalidException' with specified permissions and 'ThingId'.

methods.name: newBuilderForCause
methods.description: Creates a new builder for a 'PolicyInvalidException' caused by an underlying Throwable, associated with a specific 'ThingId'.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a 'PolicyInvalidException' from a given JsonObject, facilitating JSON-based error propagation.

methods.name: getEmptyBuilder
methods.description: Returns an empty builder instance for further customization.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the supported JSON schema versions for serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new exception instance with specified headers, preserving existing message, description, cause, and href.
